subject.title: [Feature]: /learn command — distill recent work into a reviewable skill draft

question: Should OpenClaw accept `/learn` as a built-in core command that reserves the `learn` command name and routes recent-work distillation through Skill Workshop proposals?
rationale: The request is plausible and ergonomics-aligned, but it adds a cross-channel core command near the VISION.md boundary between lean core, plugins, skills, and ClawHub; the issue also has the protected `maintainer` label and an open implementation PR.

options.title: Review the linked core command PR
options.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100442 as the candidate implementation, requiring product sign-off, review fixes, docs metadata, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Document the existing Skill Workshop flow
options.body: Keep core unchanged and improve docs/help around asking the agent or CLI to create a Skill Workshop proposal from recent work.

options.title: Route outside core
options.body: Ask for a plugin, command-extension, or ClawHub-level affordance if maintainers do not want another built-in command namespace entry.

recommendation.title: Review the linked core command PR
recommendation.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100442 as the candidate implementation, requiring product sign-off, review fixes, docs metadata, and real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected feature issue, authored the linked implementation candidate, and have recent Skill Workshop path history.
